remarks: Welcome to Cambridge Court unit 7, located in desirable downtown Stamford. This beautifully updated, sun-drenched townhouse is filled with character and light, and offers the space and layout for how we live today. Savvy buyers will love this open concept 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath condo. Tucked away from Grove Street down a tree lined courtyard, you will find the private entrance to this updated yet secluded home. Well equipped kitchen will delight the serious home chef with beautiful counters and gorgeous marble backsplash. Rich hardwood floors, sumptuous molding and custom window blinds add to the perfection. The sunny living room/dining area leads to a balcony deck and boasts a lovely fireplace. Need to work from home? A cozy nook affords you this opportunity. And updated half bath complete the first floor. Upstairs, enjoy the oversized primary suite with 2 closets and large private bath with tub, shower and double sink vanity. An additional bedroom with its own private bath adds to the perfection. Enjoy all that downtown Stamford has to offer-shopping, restaurants and walking distance to the Stamford train station. Lots of closet space, pull down attic, and garage parking, #31. And dedicated storage unit in garage. Make your home ownership dreams a reality. Move right in! Windows being sold "as is".
